adapter_provenance.method: Finding statements, dimensions and dispositions transferred unchanged from independent scientific review

reliability.rationale: The retained evidence supports the stated narrow conclusion under Whole material compositions with complete temperature/branch curves; excess uptake rather than absolute capacity. Strong adverse evidence: Idealized pressure subtraction is insufficient at cryogenic high pressure; fitted uptake and derived total-uptake/reuse quantities are not independent confirmation.

mechanism.rationale: Excess/absolute distinction and nonideal hydrogen properties are physically necessary. Two fitted sites and volume are not unique pore populations; branch mismatch does not prove hysteresis.

novelty.rationale: Leachman EOS and dual-site adsorption are established; specificationrepair and bounded curve diagnostics are the contribution. This review uses retained prior-art records only; it performs no new literature priority adjudication.

significance.rationale: The measured endpoint and matched controls supply a useful reproducible local benchmark. Whole material compositions with complete temperature/branch curves; excess uptake rather than absolute capacity.

reproducibility.rationale: Frozen equations/model states and numerical evidence are present and hash-bound here. This scientific document review is separate from independent computational replay; execution validity must be supplied by that review and the raw-preparation audit.

impact.rationale: Potential monitoring, calibration or experiment-planning value is bounded by the stated endpoint. No operational intervention, measured deployment savings, clinical effect or independent real-world benefit is demonstrated in this portfolio.

limitations: Idealized pressure subtraction is insufficient at cryogenic high pressure; fitted uptake and derived total-uptake/reuse quantities are not independent confirmation.
checks: Audit rho[g/cm³], f[bar], V[cm³/g]→wt.% dimensional consistency and normal-hydrogen assumption.
Score peaks only where an interior extremum is observed and retain boundary maxima separately.
Treat 5–100 bar excess swing as excesscurve diagnostic, not absolute deliverable capacity; freeze EOS interpolation domain.
